selector_policy.primary: streamlit key= / metric label (as specified in the contract)
selector_policy.fallback: semantic — visible heading/label text, element role, chart svg presence
selector_policy.note: 기능 테스트는 폴백으로도 채점한다. 키 불일치는 기능 점수가 아니라 contract_compliance에서만 감점.

gui_test_cases.operation: Load the app root page and wait for network idle.
gui_test_cases.expected: Main heading text equals 'NYC Taxi Explorer'.
Equals ground-truth COUNT(*) of samples.nyctaxi.trips (exact integer, commas allowed).
Equals ground-truth AVG(fare_amount) rounded to 2 decimals (tolerance ±0.01).
Equals ground-truth AVG(trip_distance) rounded to 2 decimals (tolerance ±0.01).

gui_test_cases.operation: Set start_date/end_date to a one-week window known to contain trips; wait for rerun.
gui_test_cases.expected: trips_table rows fall inside the half-open window [start 00:00, end+1d 00:00); rows ordered by tpep_pickup_datetime ASC; row count matches ground-truth query (capped at 100).

gui_test_cases.operation: After the filter change in T5, compare KPI values and (if query history is available) count KPI queries issued since page load.
gui_test_cases.expected: KPI values unchanged (full-table); no additional full-table aggregation query triggered by the filter change.

gui_test_cases.operation: Inspect the zip_chart container after the filter from T5.
gui_test_cases.expected: A bar chart with at most 10 bars; NULL pickup_zip excluded; ranking matches ground truth with ties broken by pickup_zip ASC.

gui_test_cases.operation: Set a date window with zero trips (e.g. year 1999).
gui_test_cases.expected: A friendly empty-state message is shown; no stack trace, no Streamlit exception element, app process still alive.
